I.effect_boundary: Controlled authorized test calls only; budget and targets must be concrete before paid experiments.

F: Attempt to claim unobserved live success

X.timestamp_precision: date; midnight is a date marker, not execution time
X.objective: Measure Japanese telephone sound quality after the calling prototype works.
steps: Use current official provider documentation to select available Japanese voice/model candidates and pronunciation features.
Define a fixed non-sensitive Japanese script with names, dates, numbers and addresses; preserve intended wording across candidates.

Compare actual telephone playback for intelligibility, complete wording, pronunciation, onset latency, interruption and per-call charges; also compare existing Whisper and Cohere on the same local microphone samples.
Record voice/model/version, route, sample count and listener method. Studio previews and mocked STT are not telephone evidence.
Recommend a profile change only with measured benefit; submit any implementation change as a separately scoped follow-up, preserving the accepted baseline.
acceptance: At least two available voice configurations are compared on the same route with documented observations.
Measurements distinguish telephone TTS from local microphone STT quality.
Report states sample limitations and a justified adopt/retain decision.
X.rollback: Revert only owned changes; preserve journal and evidence. Reconcile any external effects; never automatically redial.
